notes: 出口气组成按原文各图的 wet/dry basis 分别记录（模拟值，从原文 Fig 读取）

inputs.heat_loss_note: ~5-10% of thermal input for pilot plant

exit_gas_wet_mol_frac.N2: __CALCULATED__  (balance, ~0.44 for air case on wet basis)
exit_gas_wet_mol_frac._note: exit dry fracs: CO≈0.157, CO2≈0.133, H2≈0.145, CH4≈0.034 (after removing H2O)

axial_profiles._coordinate: Normierte Höhe ξ: 0-0.3 conical entry, 0.3-0.5 stationary bed, 0.5-1.0 freeboard

_observations.O2_primary: O2 consumed within first 15% height; drives T rise to ~1100 K
_observations.O2_secondary: Secondary air injection at ξ≈0.6 causes O2 spike to 0.012 and T spike to 1240 K
_observations.T_dip: Endothermic gasification (R2 C+H2O, R4 C+CO2) causes T drop from 1100→1060 K in ξ=0.2-0.45
_observations.T_spike: Secondary air combustion raises T by ~200 K at ξ≈0.6
_observations.CO_H2_dip: CO and H2 drop at ξ≈0.6 due to partial combustion, then recover via WGS equilibration
_observations.CH4_flat: CH4 stays flat ~0.025 through freeboard — minimal secondary formation/destruction
_observations.H2O_trend: Highest consumption in first 30% where devolatilization + char gasification are most intense
_observations.temperature_curve_confidence: Re-check against Hamel Fig. 7.4 confirms the main temperature anchors ξ=0.00/0.10/0.20/0.45/0.60/0.80/1.00 at roughly 750/1020/1100/1060/1240/1130/1100 K. Remaining uncertainty is mainly the fine intra-bed curvature between anchors, not the existence of the ξ≈0.6 secondary-air thermal peak itself.

hamel_plant_engineering.fuel_inlet: two points (cone + bed); screw or slanted tube
hamel_plant_engineering.agent_injection: O2/steam or air/steam, up to 10 staged levels in bed + freeboard

_observations.no_N2_dilution: O2/steam case — no N2 dilution → CO/H2 nearly double vs air case (0.335 vs 0.130)
_observations.T_peak: Secondary O2 peak at ξ≈0.6 reaches 1380 K (vs 1240 K in air case)
_observations.CO2_spike: Sharp CO2 increase at ξ≈0.6 from partial combustion of CO/H2
_observations.CH4_higher: CH4 ~0.048 (vs 0.028 in air) — enhanced secondary cracking in hotter freeboard
_observations.H2O_consumption: H2O drops from 0.38 (entry) to 0.17 (exit) — steam consumed by gasification + WGS
